MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x + 2

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 22
   C. 55
   D. 16

3. Solve for x: x + 3 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 13
   C. 12
   D. 15

4. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

5. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 12
   C. 24
   D. 36

6. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 30
   C. 75
   D. 20

7. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 48
   D. 14

8. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 90
   C. 36
   D. 81

9. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 81
   C. 9
   D. 40.5

10. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

11. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 1
   D. 2

12. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 4
   C. 12
   D. 32

13. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 11
   C. 122
   D. 121

14. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. Cannot tell
   D. They are equal

15. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 40

16. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 1
   C. 72
   D. 73

17. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 156
   C. 24
   D. 48

18. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 43
   C. 1
   D. 1

19. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.025
   C. 0.205
   D. 0.25

20. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 1
   C. 56
   D. 57

21. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 170
   C. 13
   D. 169

22. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 1

23. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 2/3
   C. 1/2
   D. 3/4

24. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 1

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
